messages:
aparna: spotted a cascade of tiny mismatches in optimize docs after the v2 runtime merge. batching examples, caching snippet, and the quant profiles page all use slightly different keys/constructors. want to consolidate before the next docs release.

jess: can you paste a couple of concrete failures?

aparna: snippet-runner output: java example throws NoClassDefFoundError for com.redwood.optimize.quant.Profile, node example uses `batch_size`, and the caching example has a broken fenced block that loses indentation when rendered.

tom: quick triage: runtime moved profile APIs into optimize.profiles and introduced QuantSpec for programmatic builds. also batching now prefers `max_batch_tokens` + `batch_window_ms`.

lina: I can take the Java + docs refactor. will add a small migration section and a short recipe showing QuantSpec composition.

jess: I'll handle node/py snippets and update the YAML files. proposing a single docs-only PR to keep history tidy.

aparna: timeline: open PR today, run snippet-runner across langs, add a grep-based CI check to prevent regressions. aim to merge by EOD if CI is green.

lina: Java snippet to replace:```java
// old
import com.redwood.optimize.quant.Profile;
Profile p = Profile.fromPreset("int8_fast");
// new
import com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantSpec;
QuantSpec p = QuantSpec.builder().preset("int8_fast").build();
```

jess: Node example patch:```js
// old
const { QuantProfile } = require('@redwood/optimize');
// new
const { QuantSpec } = require('@redwood/optimize/profiles');
const spec = QuantSpec.fromPreset('int8_fast');
```

tom: YAML batching example update suggestion:```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  batch_window_ms: 10
  prefer_kv_cache: true
```

jess: I'll also add a short recommendation in optimize/best-practices.md about when to prefer lower max_batch_tokens (low-latency vs cost). include a tiny perf note and link to the Optimize Console dashboard.

aparna: add a one-line migration note at the top of quant-profiles.md that links to docs/optimize/MIGRATE_QUANT_V2.md. also run the new grep check for `optimize.quant.Profile` and `batch_size`.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending)  running snippet-runner for java,node,py.

lina: local run shows caching.md fence indentation fixed; pushing commit.

jess: PR 4501 opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4501  includes Java/Node/Python snippets, YAML batching rename, migration doc, and grep CI rule.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed)  snippet-runner failed on the python example due to old constructor signature.

jess: pushed quick python fix and re-run. added a brief test that loads snippets as modules to catch signature mismatches.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success)  snippet tests passed.

aparna: merged PR 4501. follow-ups: tom to add a small linter in infra next sprint to enforce the new profile path, jess to add the perf blurb and product to include migration note in release highlights.

tom: will open infra PR for the linter and add an allowlist for archived samples.

lina: leaving a short checklist in the migration doc for other langs (go, rust, ruby) to make it easy to sweep later.

aparna: great work team 680
